title: Custom Furniture Crafted to Your Space
bannerCopy: Handcrafted tables, seating, storage, and statement pieces proportioned to your room dimensions, daily habits, and natural wood grain.
overview: Ready-made pieces rarely fit real rooms without compromise. At Royal Grain Woodcraft & Interiors, every furniture piece is built around your exact measurements, comfort needs, and interior tone—combining sturdy joinery with rich natural finishes.

listCards.text: Solid wood dining tables, benches, and sideboards
Lounge chairs, coffee tables, and console units
Custom beds, nightstands, and bedroom storage
Study desks, bookshelves, and compact multi-use pieces

focusText: Thoughtful grain matching, smooth edge profiling, and durable finishes designed for everyday family living.

title: Architectural & Interior Woodwork
bannerCopy: Teakwood doors, wall paneling, ceiling details, and built-in joinery that bring warmth and structure across interiors.
overview: Fine woodwork gives an interior its character and permanence. From main entrance doors to subtle wall accents and fluted or paneled surfaces, we focus on clean alignment, proportion, and lasting timber strength.

listCards.text: Main entrance doors, frames, and interior doors
Wall paneling, acoustic/decorative slats, and wainscoting
Ceiling accents, beams, and architraves
Built-in niches, partitions, and custom millwork

focusText: Seasoned timber selection, precision fitting on site, and finishes that highlight natural grain depth.

title: Bespoke Interiors Tailored to You
bannerCopy: One-of-a-kind interior spaces designed from scratch around your lifestyle, aesthetic preferences, and functional flow.
overview: Bespoke design starts with listening—how you host, unwind, work, and move through a space. We shape cohesive layouts, custom joinery, and warm material palettes so every corner feels intentional rather than templated.

listCards.text: Concept-led spatial planning and custom design direction
One-off statement joinery and tailored storage solutions
Harmonized palettes of warm woods, stone, fabric, and soft lighting
Personalized detailing with zero cookie-cutter templates

focusText: Close collaboration from initial concept to final installation, keeping every detail cohesive.

title: Warm, Livable Residential Interiors
bannerCopy: Homes, villas, and apartments crafted for calm daily routines, generous storage, and welcoming family spaces.
overview: A home should feel grounding the moment you walk in. We design and execute residential interiors that balance warm teakwood tones and practical everyday storage with spaces made for gathering and rest.

listCards.text: Living rooms, dining areas, and family lounges
Modular & custom kitchens, pantries, and crockery units
Bedrooms, walk-in wardrobes, and dressing zones
Pooja units, foyers, and utility/storage spaces

focusText: Easy-to-maintain surfaces, smart storage zoning, and durable craftsmanship suited for years of daily use.

title: Refined Commercial Interiors
bannerCopy: Workspaces, studios, retail spaces, and client-facing environments built for durability, clarity, and brand presence.
overview: Commercial spaces need to leave a lasting impression on visitors while supporting smooth daily operations. We create structured, welcoming interiors with sturdy finishes that hold up to high footfall and regular use.

listCards.text: Executive cabins, meeting rooms, and collaborative offices
Reception desks, waiting lounges, and display walls
Retail showrooms, boutiques, and product showcases
Studios, clinics, and hospitality touchpoints

focusText: High-wear materials, clean cable/utility integration, and dependable timelines aligned with your opening schedule.
